chapter 8 Your Body: Temple, Fortress, or Foe? 
activity 70 stopping comparisons
for you to know
The clearest sign of body acceptance and respect is when you stop checking out others’ bodies to 
see how you match up. Comparing yourself to others can only make you feel envious and dislike 
yourself more, or make you feel superior if you think your body is better. Neither of these feelings 
is comfortable, and both can cause you a great deal of pain. Envy means you’re focusing on what 
you don’t have, and superiority is shallow and short-lived.
The best thing you can do is to forget about others—your own personal qualities are what 
counts!
